name: s6-interactive-experiences-lab
description: Stage-2 stream S6: an accessible drag-and-drop canvas toy in six variants (canvas only, focusable proxies, form alternative, hybrid, PixiJS AccessibilitySystem defaults and enabled), canvas pointer hit targets, a canvas accessibility probe validated on 25 pages, UI-sound payloads and browser-compat rows, and facts read from open-source web games. Run: npm install && sh fetch-sources.sh && node run.mjs
